channel.title: Boulder Daily Camera - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Boulder Daily Camera (dailycamera.com)

item.title: Colorado dominates first half, then holds on to post road win at Utah
item.description: Colorado fans are painfully aware of some of the ugly results the Buffaloes have posted on the road over the past five weeks.

item.title: Gloo raises 2026 sales outlook on heels of layoffs
item.description: Gloo Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: GLOO), a Boulder-based company that provides artificial intelligence and technology platforms for faith-based organizations, beat sales projections in the fourth quarter of last year and has raised its 2026 revenue expectations.

item.title: Gaia’s 2025 sales neared $100M
item.description: LOUISVILLE — Streaming video provider Gaia Inc. (Nasdaq: GAIA) posted $99 million in sales during fiscal 2025, an 11% year-over-year improvement.

item.title: Sebastian Rancik sidelined for CU Buffs at Utah
item.description: With Colorado still battling for a more favorable spot in the first round of the Big 12 Conference tournament, the Buffaloes went into the final regular season road game without one of their best players.

item.title: JumpCloud hires info-security chief
item.description: LOUISVILLE — JumpCloud Inc., an IT access-management platform, recently hired Roland Palmer as its chief information security officer and vice president of security.

item.title: Transformative Biotech appoints industry veteran to leadership role
item.description: Transformative Biotech LLC, a Boulder-based company working to develop faster molecular tests for diseases such as COVID-19 and cancer, has appointed Mark Kelleher as executive vice president of research and development.

item.title: Biodesix expects 2026 sales to crack $100M
item.description: LOUISVILLE — Biodesix Inc. (Nasdaq: BDSX), a life-sciences company that specializes in developing tools to detect lung disease, improved its top and bottom lines in both the fourth quarter of last year and the full 2025 fiscal year.

item.title: Gogo predicts 2026 sales as high as $945M
item.description: Gogo Inc. (Nasdaq: GOGO), a Broomfield-based company that provides broadband connectivity services for business and government aviation markets, posted significant year-over-year sales increases in both the fourth quarter of last year and the full 2025 fiscal year, largely driven by its acquisition of SatCom Direct Inc.

item.title: Broadband firm Vero dials up $500M from investors
item.description: VFN Holdings Inc., a Boulder fiber infrastructure company and broadband internet provider that does business as Vero Networks and Vero Fiber, recently secured a $500 million investment that it plans to use in part to fuel its acquisition strategy.

item.title: Edgewise boosts R&D spending in Q4 with drug milestones in sight
item.description: Edgewise Therapeutics Inc. (Nasdaq: EWTX), a Boulder-based biopharmaceutical company that develops therapies for muscle disease, spent more on research and development and administration during the fourth quarter of the 2025 fiscal year as clinical development activities for a handful of its drug candidates gained steam.
